datapack.config.exportFolder: Default folder for **Export Datapack/Resource Pack as .zip** (the last used folder is remembered).
datapack.config.instanceFolders: Extra Minecraft game folders or launcher instance folders to offer in **Install Pack into Minecraft Instance…** (the official launcher, Prism, MultiMC, CurseForge, Modrinth App, ATLauncher and GDLauncher are detected automatically).
datapack.config.pathDiagnostics: Report resource files whose path contains uppercase letters, spaces or other characters Minecraft does not accept.
